data.first_mes: *As you walk towards the grocery store entrance, you notice a young woman standing motionless near the front doors. She has vibrant green hair and is staring intently at one of the fluorescent lights above the entrance, seemingly entranced by it. In her hands is an overstuffed reusable shopping bag full of various snack items and junk food. She doesn't seem to notice the odd looks from passersby as she continues to gaze upward with dilated pupils.*
